title: 11，肉身监控！！！！
slug: 人在俄乌当佣兵杀敌就能爆属性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“我不知道有没有地狱。”

沈飞看了一眼不远处的维克多，声音有些沙哑地说：“但我知道，如果我们再不回射击坑，马上就会被自己人打死。”

穆萨一愣，下意识的顺着沈飞的目光看过去。

维克多正站在一处猫耳洞门口。

他脸上全都是泥水和血水的混合物，额头被不知道哪里飞来的碎片划出一道口子，血顺着眉骨往下流，糊住了半边脸。

他胸前挂着一台民用对讲机。

塑料外壳已经被泥糊住，天线歪斜，里面还在不断传出断断续续的呵斥声。

“....回位置....全员警戒........可能接触....”

“.....再不就位....按逃兵处理...”

电流声滋滋作响，夹杂着远处还没完全停下来的炮声，听起来像一张催命符。

维克多低头看着猫耳洞里的人，沉声道，“我再说一遍，出来！”

洞里的人明显已经被炸破了胆，蜷缩在最里面，死死抱着枪，声音发抖地大骂：“去你妈的！”

“我不出去，我要活着，我不想被炸碎，我不想死在这鬼地方！！！”

维克多表情彻底阴沉，干脆利落的举枪射击。

枪声在狭窄的壕沟里响起，洞里的骂声戛然而止。

血和碎裂的组织溅在洞壁上，也喷了维克多半张脸。

壕沟里瞬间安静了，所有人都僵住了。

穆萨也被吓了一跳，几乎是本能地一把抓住沈飞的胳膊。

他的手很大，力气也很大，抓得沈飞胳膊一疼。

可穆萨很快发现，沈飞脸上的表情并没有多少意外，像是早就猜到会发生这一幕。

穆萨喉结动了动，压低声音问：“你怎么知道他会杀人？”

沈飞看了一眼维克多胸前还在滋滋作响的对讲机说：“因为组长不是那么好干的，他要是不让人回射击位，督战队就会处理他。”

“他不想死，就只能先让别人死。”

穆萨沉默了。

沈飞继续说道，“别看他凶神恶煞的，但其实维克多的情绪已经崩了，听他的命令，同时离他远点。”

穆萨很认真地点了点头。

另一边，维克多缓缓转身，脸上挂着血，眼睛里布满血丝：“所有人回射击坑，全员警戒！”

“谁再躲在洞里，老子先杀谁！”

这一次，再也没人敢犹豫。

还缩在猫耳洞里的人几乎是连滚带爬地钻了出来。

沈飞没有继续看热闹，拎着AK-74M自动步枪，弯着腰，迅速扫了一眼附近几个射击坑。

"I don't know if there is a hell."

Shen Fei glanced at Victor who was not far away, and said in a hoarse voice: "But I know that if we don't return to the shooting pit, we will be killed by our own people immediately."

Musa was stunned and subconsciously followed Shen Fei's gaze.

Victor was standing at the door of a cat-ear hole.

His face was covered with a mixture of mud and blood, and his forehead was cut open by debris flying from nowhere. Blood flowed down his brow bone, covering half of his face.

A civilian walkie-talkie hung on his chest.

The plastic shell was covered in mud, the antenna was crooked, and intermittent yelling continued to come from inside.

"...Return to position...All personnel are on alert...Possible contact..."

"...If you don't get in position...you will be treated as a deserter..."

The sound of electric current was sizzling, mixed with the sound of cannons in the distance that had not completely stopped, and it sounded like a reminder.

Victor looked down at the person in the cat-ear hole and said solemnly, "I say it again, come out!"

The person in the cave was obviously scared. He huddled in the innermost place, holding the gun tightly, and shouted in a trembling voice: "Go to hell!"

"I'm not going out, I want to live, I don't want to be blown to pieces, I don't want to die in this hellish place!!!"

Victor's expression was completely gloomy, and he raised his gun and fired.

Gunshots rang out in the narrow trench, and the curses in the cave stopped abruptly.

Blood and broken tissue spattered on the cave wall and sprayed half of Victor's face.

The trench fell silent for a moment, and everyone froze.

Musa was also startled and grabbed Shen Fei's arm almost instinctively.

His hands were big and strong, which made Shen Fei's arm hurt when he grabbed them.

But Musa soon discovered that there was not much surprise in the expression on Shen Fei's face, as if he had already guessed that this scene would happen.

Musa's Adam's apple moved, and he lowered his voice and asked, "How do you know he will kill someone?"

Shen Fei glanced at the walkie-talkie that was still buzzing on Victor's chest and said, "Because the team leader is not that easy to do. If he doesn't let people return to the shooting position, the supervising team will deal with him."

"If he doesn't want to die, he can only let others die first."

Musa was silent.

Shen Fei continued, "Although he looks fierce, Victor's mood has actually collapsed. Listen to his orders and stay away from him."

Musa nodded seriously.

On the other side, Victor turned around slowly, with blood on his face and bloodshot eyes: "Everyone go back to the shooting pit, everyone is on alert!"

"Whoever hides in the cave again, I will kill first!"

This time, no one dared to hesitate.

The person who was still huddled in the cat's ear hole almost crawled out.

Shen Fei did not continue to watch the excitement. He carried the AK-74M automatic rifle, bent down, and quickly glanced at several nearby shooting pits.
